findings.title: draft-review 用短 ID "DRAFT-9001" 无法解析（需完整文件名 stem）
findings.evidence: python3 scripts/ohc-run.py draft-review DRAFT-9001 --json => exit 1, '❌ 草稿不存在: DRAFT-9001（可用: 前 5 个 DRAFT-6048-..., DRAFT-6049-...）'。脚本 scripts/ohc/draft_review.py:208-211 用 `d.stem == draft_id or d.stem == f'DRAFT-{draft_id}'` 精确匹配文件名 stem；本仓草稿命名一律带描述后缀（如 DRAFT-6048-babeltrace-glibtest-autotools）。用完整 stem `draft-review DRAFT-9001-libcsys-5.0.0-ohos-runtime-crashes --json` => exit 0, verdict=create, 无重复。
findings.recommendation: 非缺陷，仅为调用约定：以完整文件名 stem 调用即可。无需修改包内容。

findings.title: 知识草稿用 YAML 块标量 '>'，draft-review 将其判为『空壳/has_root_cause=false』
findings.evidence: draft-review <full-stem> --json 输出 quality.has_root_cause=false、empty_drafts=1，全量报告标 '⚠️空壳'。原因：draft_review.py:176-178 要求 len(root_cause.strip())>20，而其朴素解析器 _parse_simple_fields 只取单行值；草稿用 `root_cause: >` 折叠块标量 → 值为 '>' → 判定为空。该草稿字段实际完整（error_signature/match_keywords/root_cause/rec_approach 均非空，见 .kv 文件）。同类块标量草稿 164/616，含最新 DRAFT-6048；全量 201/604 被标空壳 → 工具解析限制，非本包内容缺陷。
findings.recommendation: 无需阻塞。若希望 draft-review 给出 has_root_cause=true，可把 root_cause/rec_description 改为单行值（与 formal E 条目一致）；否则维持现状（与 164 份同类草稿一致）。

findings.title: patch_description 为长英文句、patch_type=bugfix（code-style §12 示例为短语/portability）
findings.evidence: conandata.yml:12 `patch_description: "Fix three upstream runtime defects exposed on HarmonyOS: ..."`；patch_type=bugfix。code-style.md §12 示例给 `patch_description: "0001 build aux config.guess"`、`patch_type: "portability"`。但 knowledge/ARCHIVE-SPEC.md §4.3 明确 patch_type 取值 `portability / bugfix / backport`，故 bugfix 合规；patch_description 仅为措辞风格差异（ARCHIVE-SPEC 仅要求 string）。
findings.recommendation: 可选：将 patch_description 精简为短语。patch_type=bugfix 保留（语义更准确且被 ARCHIVE-SPEC 允许）。

findings.title: 版本级 manifest.yaml 未含可选字段 conan_ref
findings.evidence: archives/l/libcsys/5.0.0/manifest.yaml 无 conan_ref 字段。ARCHIVE-SPEC.md §4.2 将该字段列为『推荐』（非必须）。其余必填字段（version/status/build_date/source.url/build.system）齐备。
findings.recommendation: 可选：补 `conan_ref: "libcsys/5.0.0"` 以与 ARCHIVE-SPEC 模板对齐。

findings.title: test_package 直接链接 libcsys.so 而非 find_package(csys)（ARCHIVE-SPEC §2.2 纯库最低要求）
findings.evidence: test_package/CMakeLists.txt:13-16 用 ${CSYS_INCLUDE_DIR}/${CSYS_LIBRARY}（由 conanfile.py 经 toolchain 变量注入），未做 find_package(csys)。原因：上游未安装 CMake config 包，配方 package_info() 设 cmake_find_mode=none（与 qtbase-sql-dbus、kdbusaddons/6.14.0 同款），find_package(csys) 不可用。已在 notes.md/README.md 说明。test_package 仍真实编译并运行二进制（日志 `RUN: ./test_libcsys`）。
findings.recommendation: 无需阻塞（设计使然且有据）。如需完全满足模板最低要求，可另加一个 pkg-config(csys) 消费断言。

findings.title: test-report.md §4.2 记录了整仓扫描模式 JC 门禁 FAIL（由其它包 cloog 引发）
findings.evidence: test-report.md §4.2 载明全仓模式 JC_RESULT=fail，系 archives/c/cloog/0.21.1 的 .build-closed/.staging-verified 存量文件（已随 main 合入），与本包无关；prdiff 模式（真实 CI）下 L0/L1/L2/L4/L5 全 pass。属透明披露，非本包缺陷。
findings.recommendation: 无需处理；已如实说明归因。

The test_package genuinely compiles and runs against the real csys/*.h API (41 real assertions) and test() executes the binary (log: 'RUN: ./test_libcsys', 'assertions=41 failures=0'). All three patch hunks correspond to real upstream defects and are type/behaviour-correct (QList<qreal>::value(qsizetype, qreal) is valid; inverted dtor condition fixed; gethostname return-value misuse fixed without introduced bugs), and apply cleanly. No fabricated state: .ci-result.json log_sha256 equals the sha256 of reports/w3-local-ci.log, and the conan build log is internally consistent (ctest 'No tests were found!!!' for the honestly-declared 0 upstream tests). Recipe is correct: 4 settings, name/version match, requirement is qtbase-sql-dbus/6.11.1 (not qtbase -> Qt6DBus present), package_type=library, cmake_find_mode=none, first-adaptation version with no suffix, official upstream URL, kdbusaddons-style SONAME injection. No placeholders; test counts self-consistent (41/0/exit0) across manifest.yaml, MANIFEST.yml, test-report.md, the .cpp and the log. graph validate exits 0; DRAFT-9001 has complete fields and no duplicate. Only non-blocking P3/informational notes (F1-F6) remain. Caveat: the package was audited via the recorded conan create artifacts and logs (the full build was not re-run by this auditor); patch correctness was verified by static/mostly-dry-run comparison, not by re-compiling.
